# Telegram Web K icons

These unmodified SVG files are from morethanwords/tweb at commit 654ffd809aa402f31357db2a13c462b4e5b69a23. The upstream GPL-3.0 license is included. Their original names are recorded in manifest.json. Payo renders them as monochrome CSS masks using the active Telegram theme color.

Source: https://github.com/morethanwords/tweb/tree/654ffd809aa402f31357db2a13c462b4e5b69a23/assets/icons
